name: context-mode
description: Free, local plugin that keeps tool output out of your coding agent's context window. Sandbox and SQLite FTS5 search, 99% fewer bytes in context. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and 4 more agents. Zero telemetry.

issues.title: doctor FAIL: gemini extensions list requires auth/API key in non-interactive subprocess
Codex: setup pins plugin version dir in config.toml/hooks.json; Codex plugin auto-update deletes it and hooks break
`setup` generates a PowerShell hook command that fails to parse (two adjacent quoted paths)
[Bug]: ctx_execute with language: "python" returns "Internal error" on Windows when the Microsoft Store python alias is first on PATH (statSync throws EACCES)
Feature request: per-tool opt-out for output replacement
A setting to turn off the WebFetch hint/deny
Feature request: stateless shared daemon mode (one process per machine, Streamable HTTP) so RAM stops scaling with session count
Feature request: return a stored source in full (`ctx_get`)

latest_release.name: v2.1.10
latest_release.body:
### Fixes
- fix(doctor): env line names the PATH node for ctx_execute, PATH node version read beside the checks (#1350)
- fix(doctor): D5 bound scales with the node start, in-process hosts check shape only, env line names the host Bun (#1350)

### Who gets this

One version on both channels: the release commit on main (GitHub) and npm.

| Agent | Channel | Update with |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | GitHub | `claude plugin update context-mode@context-mode` |
| Codex | GitHub, npm for the one-time hook trust step | `codex plugin marketplace upgrade context-mode` |
| Gemini CLI | GitHub | `gemini extensions update context-mode` |
| Qwen Code | GitHub | `qwen extensions update context-mode` |
| Copilot CLI | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| VS Code (Copilot) | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| Kiro | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| ZCode | GitHub | `zcode plugins update context-mode@context-mode` |
| Pi | npm | `pi update --extensions` |
| OpenCode | npm | `opencode plugin update` |
